entities.summary: The Kuching Cat Museum is a cat museum in Kuching, Sarawak, Malaysia. It was founded in 1993 and it is owned by the Kuching North City Hall (DBKU), and housed in their headquarters. "Kuching" translates to "cat" in Malay. It is the first museum in the world built to showcase entirely on cats.
